changeSet.sql: IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'tag')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Tag]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_createdOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_createdBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_updatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_updatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Tag] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
